backend/main.mo: Main Motoko actor defining all backend data types, state (comment lists, app events, chat messages, images, settings, pricing, withdrawals), and business logic for a content/feedback manager app with authorization and blob storage mixins.
feature_evidence.json: Empty feature evidence report JSON file with no features listed.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: JSON document containing short summaries of each frontend source file, describing the purpose and key implementation details of each component, hook, and view.
frontend/index.css: Tailwind CSS entry file defining OKLCH-based CSS custom properties for light and dark themes, covering background, foreground, card, border, chart, and sidebar color tokens.
frontend/index.html: Minimal HTML entry point that mounts the React app into a root div and loads the main TypeScript module.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Root app component with a tabbed layout (Comment, Live, Upload, Admin), a midnight countdown banner, light/dark theme toggle, and background music playback control using settings from the backend.
frontend/src/components/AdminUnlock.tsx: Admin unlock screen component that prompts for a passcode, uses the useAdminAuth hook to validate it, and auto-skips if a valid code is already stored in localStorage.
frontend/src/components/BulkCommentGener: Bulk comment generator component that validates an access key, generates multiple comments client-side from a selected list using useCommentGenerator, decrements inventory, and provides a copy-all button.
frontend/src/components/MetricsDonutChar: Renders an SVG donut chart showing the percentage of used templates out of total templates, with a gradient arc and centered percentage text.
frontend/src/components/TopDownShooter.t: A canvas-based top-down shooter mini-game where the player moves with keyboard input, shoots bullets by clicking, and avoids enemies that spawn from the edges.
frontend/src/components/UploadComment.ts: A form component that lets users type and submit a comment via the `useAddChatMessage` mutation, displaying loading, success, and error states.
A modal dialog that collects a 10-digit wallet number and submits a withdrawal request for a user's earnings using the `useCheckAndRequestWithdrawal` mutation.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Creates and caches an authenticated or anonymous backend actor using React Query, reinitializing and invalidating dependent queries when the Internet Identity changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useAdminAuth.ts: Manages admin authentication state by validating a hardcoded code, persisting the result in localStorage, and exposing unlock/lock functions.
frontend/src/hooks/useBackgroundMusic.ts: Controls an HTML Audio element for background music, handling play/pause based on a provided URL and enabled flag, and exposing play/pause controls.
frontend/src/hooks/useClaimedComments.ts: Provides localStorage-backed helpers to store, retrieve, and check whether a device has already claimed a comment for a given list ID.
frontend/src/hooks/useCommentGenerator.t: Exposes functions to randomly generate a single comment or a bulk array of comments from a `CommentList`'s templates, optionally appending a suffix or symbol.
frontend/src/hooks/useCountdown.ts: Returns a live countdown (hours, minutes, seconds) to the next midnight, updating every second via `setInterval`.
frontend/src/hooks/useDeviceId.ts: Generates and persists a UUID device identifier in localStorage, returning the same ID on subsequent renders.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Provides a React context and hook for Internet Identity authentication on the ICP platform, managing login state, identity persistence, and AuthClient lifecycle.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Defines React Query hooks (queries and mutations) for all backend actor interactions including comment lists, events, chat, images, settings, pricing, and withdrawals.
frontend/src/index.css: Global stylesheet that imports fonts, sets up Tailwind CSS, and defines CSS custom properties for dark and light themes including color tokens for gold, teal, and countdown banner styles.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Application entry point that mounts the React app with QueryClientProvider and InternetIdentityProvider wrappers around the root App component.
frontend/src/utils/liveListParser.ts: Parses a structured text report format into app entries with usernames and dates, using regex patterns to identify date lines, app name blocks, and numbered username lines.
frontend/src/utils/templateGenerator.ts: Generates randomized app review comment templates by combining tone-specific adjectives and phrase banks across categories (performance, UI, features, support) with variable length suffixes.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Utility functions for reading URL parameters from both query strings and hash-based routing, with sessionStorage persistence and helpers to clean sensitive params from the URL bar.
frontend/src/views/admin/AdminAITemplate: An admin tool that generates comment templates locally based on topic, tone, count, and an optional appended symbol, then allows selecting and adding them to a comment list.
frontend/src/views/admin/AdminChat.tsx: An admin chat panel that displays stored chat messages with timestamps and allows sending new messages via a simple form.
frontend/src/views/admin/AdminComments.t: Admin panel view for managing comment lists, including creating, renaming, deleting, locking/unlocking lists, adding templates, and setting inventory counts with a donut chart metrics display.
frontend/src/views/admin/AdminEarnings.t: Admin panel view that displays earnings summaries including total apps with prices, total entries, total earnings, and a per-app breakdown table with a refresh button.
frontend/src/views/admin/AdminImages.tsx: Admin panel view for uploading images with a name, tags, and file picker, and displaying a gallery of existing images fetched from the backend.
frontend/src/views/admin/AdminLiveList.t: Admin panel view for managing app events and their associated username lists, supporting manual entry, bulk text/file upload, and auto-import via a parsed live list report.
frontend/src/views/admin/AdminPricing.ts: Admin panel view for managing per-app price entries, supporting adding, editing, deleting individual entries, and bulk CSV-style uploads.
frontend/src/views/admin/AdminSettings.t: Admin settings panel component for managing the access key (set/regenerate/show) and background music (toggle enable/disable, upload file) with success/error feedback.
frontend/src/views/admin/AdminView.tsx: Top-level admin panel view that gates access behind AdminUnlock, then renders a tabbed interface switching between all admin sub-views (comments, live list, pricing, earnings, withdrawals, AI templates, images, chat, settings).
frontend/src/views/admin/AdminWithdrawal: Read-only admin view that fetches and displays all withdrawal requests grouped by status (pending, approved, rejected) with summary stats and a refresh button.
frontend/src/views/LiveChecker.tsx: A view for checking if usernames appear in app event lists, supporting single and bulk modes, with earnings calculation and a withdrawal modal triggered when a user is found.
frontend/src/views/UploadView.tsx: An admin upload page that allows uploading comment templates from a file to a selected list, generating bulk comments, and uploading rating images.
frontend/src/views/UserView.tsx: A user-facing view for selecting a comment list and claiming/generating a unique comment, with clipboard copy support and localStorage persistence of claimed comments.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind CSS configuration extending the default theme with custom fonts (Orbitron, Rajdhani), OKLCH-based color tokens, glass/glow box shadows, border radii, and keyframe animations; includes animate, typography, and container-queries plugins.
project_state.json: Project state metadata describing pending backend-only fix tasks (AR-1 through AR-7) to implement missing Motoko backend operations for comment lists, live list events, access keys, music uploads, and other admin features.
